title: Undertow and Weather
author: Felix Brightwater
blurb: Isandro Marchetti, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
